findings.description: No concrete lexical defect found. Quote handling, identifier boundaries, exact dollar delimiters and nested comments satisfy the inspected contract.
findings.evidence: candidate/src/sql_statements.py:13–96. Reviewer execution passed 21 lexical cases extracted from candidate.patch and 12 additional boundary/error probes.

findings.description: Integration validates the complete file before executing statements and preserves discovery, signature, patch seam, ledger ordering and explicit commits.
findings.evidence: candidate/src/migrations.py:7–74 versus original/src/migrations.py. Five in-memory runner scenarios passed, including malformed trailing SQL, filename skipping and an execution failure after a committed earlier file.

findings.description: Full unchanged-suite compliance and real PostgreSQL execution remain unverified here, rather than demonstrated defects. Acceptance reports 40 passes and zero skips but provides no test identities. Project tests appear in the patch but are absent from the candidate source snapshot.
findings.evidence: acceptance.json functional_result and context; candidate.patch adds tests/test_migration_sql.py with database assertions. The supplied workspace contains neither project test files nor independent test implementation. Reviewer probes used no database.

findings.description: The independent design covers requirements 1–6 with meaningful behavioral and database assertions, but supplies no predeclared mutation-sensitivity analysis. Requirement 7 is delegated to the controller; exact console wording and default directory behavior are explicitly untested.
findings.evidence: test-design.json cases and limitations. Execution coverage cannot be inferred from the aggregate acceptance count.

rationale: Accept the inspected implementation: it is focused, maintainable, introduces no runtime dependency, and has no demonstrated behavioral defect. Acceptance reports 40 passing tests; additional read-only probes passed. Database and full-suite verification remain evidence gaps. The workflow cleanup failure is separate from candidate correctness, and an architecture KEEP/SIMPLIFY/REPLACE decision is INCONCLUSIVE without comparable outcomes and verified isolation.
